Standard: The drag or spin chute system has provisions to manually release the chute when deployed to prevent loss of air vehicle control. A frangible device prevents overload conditions in the case of inadvertent deployment. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of flight manual verifies flight and ground envelopes where the flight crew can deploy the drag or spin chute. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct stress analysis to verify frangible device (e.g., D-ring) and chute releases at specified load condition. Demonstration.
    (1) Conduct ground demonstration to verify flight crew's ability to manually release the chute. Test.
      (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory load testing of mechanisms (e.g., mechanical fuse) to verify that the frangible device fails, and chute is released at specified load condition.
